_about: CAMPGROUND v1: -zoneshot:<dir> shots (ZoneShot.cs). 'stand' = zones.json spot the player is teleported to (rings / NPCs / creature wake there as in play); cam / look = zones.json spot + [x,y,z] metre offset (spot ground height from a down ray). Game camera into a RenderTexture, no screen grab. flipY only if a build proves the PNG upside down (sidecar logs top / bottom luma).
